place: the chip beside a bank card

moments.what: the graphics card turns on the stage, fans spinning, its parts lifting apart
the bare chip rises out of the card and glows at its edges
a bank card slides in beside it at true scale
the camera pushes in on the chip's surface
a single tiny cell on the surface flares amber

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: This NVIDIA chip is smaller than a bank card. How small is one switch?

moments.what: one big glowing block on the chip cracks apart
the pieces scatter across the surface
the grid of cores starts lighting from the centre and the count starts climbing on the chip's edge
thousands of small cores light up in a grid, the count written on the chip's edge
the count lands on the chip's edge with a flash
a wave of light runs across every core at once

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: And it isn't one big brain. It's 16,384 small ones, all working at once.

moments.what: the monitor's game picture breaks into a grid of tiles
the tiles fly back toward the PC tower, its side glass glowing
the game picture rebuilds on the monitor
the camera pushes into one tile: a few dots fill with colour
the dots pulse once

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: They split up every single frame of your game, so each one only colours its own patch of dots, over and over.

params.place: the chip from above, like a city at night

moments.what: the camera looks down at the green board, the die at its centre
the die lifts off its green board
it turns flat under the camera, a rainbow sheen on its surface
the camera dives down toward it
blocks rise from the surface like buildings, lanes of light between them
the camera glides over the blocks like a plane at night

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: So where are they all? Lift the silicon out and zoom in: it looks like a city at night, seen from a plane.

moments.what: the camera dives into one block, streaking
a pointer lands on the core, it glows amber
the camera tilts down onto the core's surface
the glow drains away to plain grey
rows of tiny switches appear, packed tight
the camera lands just above them

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: But dive into just one core. What's doing the maths? No magic. Just tiny switches.

moments.what: one switch is singled out by a scan ring
it lights up
it goes dark
a one and a zero write on above it
the one switch blinks on and off once
the camera starts lifting off the switch
a wave of switches flicks on and off, and a coloured dot forms above the field
the red, green and blue merge and the coloured dot pops out

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Each one is either on or off, a one or a zero. That's really it. And every single colour you see is built from them.

params.place: a wafer on a clean-room table

moments.what: an older wafer slides onto a clean-room table
one die on it is picked out and glows
its count counts up on the table's edge
the camera starts drifting back across the bench, the older die's count settles
the count on the bench's edge pulses bigger once
the camera pulls back over the bench and the old die's glow dims

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: The chip before this one already held 28B of them. Back then, that sounded like a lot.

moments.what: the switch field fills the chip edge to edge, its count lands in amber
the amber count flashes bigger as it lands
the camera pulls back to the whole chip
the bank card slides in beside it again
both settle on the reflective floor, the figure glowing above the chip

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: This one packs 76B, all on a piece of silicon smaller than a bank card.

params.place: pulling back out to the studio stage

moments.what: the camera rushes back up out of the switches
an amber wave races across the switches below
the grid of cores flashes past
the card's fans close back over the chip
the graphics card turns on the stage, as in the first frame

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: So zoom all the way back out, past the switches, past the cores, past the fans, to this NVIDIA chip.
